notes: Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512_q4_block32_ekv4096.litertlm as uploaded to litert-community/Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512 on 2026-10-06 (Hub commit 85b1913e): graph rewrite of the previous Hub file (KV-cache writes -> odml.cache_update, attention products -> odml.runtime_bmm, param_tensor input, broadcast mask add) plus one copied 16-token prefill signature; the weights are byte-identical to the previous file (sha256 57daeeb4d712...), which this upload replaced. Built and measured by the litertlm-convert GPU graph re-ship lane (rounds 1-21). Mac gate of this file (round 19, litertlm-convert gpu_reship_work/results/ship_verify): 6/6 points — weights and every other section byte-identical to the previous file, tflite CPU outputs bit-identical, litert-lm CPU answers 9/9 byte-identical, GPU (WebGPU) fully delegated with fp32 activations 9/9 byte-identical; GPU fp16 (the default) final answers 8/8 against 8/8 without the 16-token signature. Galaxy S26 GPU gate (round 16, Session path, greedy): 4/4 questions, long prompt correct, the same points as the file without the 16-token signature on the same phone (that gate ran the earlier subgraph order of the same graph; the shipped order answers byte-identically on the Mac, round 19). Previous file on the same Mac in the same lock window (litert-lm 0.17.1, same flags): gpu p256 d256: decode 92.4 tok/s, prefill 1215.31 tok/s, TTFT 0.226 s; gpu p16 d32: decode 88.78 tok/s, prefill 151.36 tok/s, TTFT 0.1213 s; cpu p256 d256: decode 22.14 tok/s, prefill 119.97 tok/s, TTFT 2.5182 s; cpu p16 d32: decode 17.34 tok/s, prefill 15.38 tok/s, TTFT 1.4782 s. iPhone 18 Pro: CPU answers of this file 9/9 byte-identical to the file without the 16-token signature on the same phone (round 21, 8 questions + a long prompt); the Metal gate of this file ran in round 15. Galaxy S26 rows: Google's prebuilt litert_lm_advanced_main (sha256 adac974b...) and libLiteRtOpenClAccelerator.so (d9dd64c3...) fetched on 2026-10-04 from storage.googleapis.com/litert/binaries/latest/android_arm64/litert_lm/ (object last-modified 2026-09-18; the binary carries the string 0.18.0 and prints no version line; LiteRT-LM main that day = 56c67f7d, the binary's own commit unconfirmed), so the snapshot axis is the digest token prebuilt-adac974b until the owner names it (DECISIONS #174(2)). Each figure is the median of the iterations of one process; per-iteration values are in metrics (iteration 1 starts cold at the full clock ceiling, later ones run under the phone's own thermal cap).
quantization: int4 weights - blockwise (block 32), symmetric, OCTAV clipping; tied embedding/lm_head at INT8
